defs.name: Smart Home: Room Navigation Sidebar
defs.genInstructions: Build a vertical sidebar listing all home rooms/zones (Living Room, Kitchen, Bedroom, etc.) with icons, each showing a quick count of active devices; selecting a room sets the active-room context for the rest of the panel. Include an 'All / Whole Home' option and an add-room control.
defs.role: The primary spatial navigator that scopes the entire panel to a chosen room and drives which devices, climate zone, and cameras the other components display.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: On room selection, emit the selected room ID; the Device Control Grid re-queries and re-renders only the devices assigned to that room (or all devices when 'Whole Home' is chosen).

targets.name: Smart Home: Climate Thermostat Panel
targets.description: On room selection, emit the selected room ID; the Climate Thermostat Panel switches to display and control that room's thermostat/zone setpoint and current temperature.

targets.name: Smart Home: Security Monitoring Panel
targets.description: On room selection, emit the selected room ID; the Security Monitoring Panel filters its camera feeds, door/window sensors, and locks to those belonging to the selected room (or shows all when 'Whole Home').

defs.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
defs.genInstructions: Build a grid of device control cards (lights with dimmers/color, plugs, fans, blinds, TVs) for the active room, each card with a power toggle and inline adjustment (slider/color swatch); this is the main device-manipulation surface.
defs.role: The central device manipulation surface that toggles and adjusts individual devices for the scoped room, feeding its state to the status header and energy dashboard.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigation Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected room ID and renders only that room's device cards (or all devices for 'Whole Home').

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scenes & Automation Panel
effectors.description: When a scene is activated, receives the scene's per-device state map (on/off, brightness, color) and updates the corresponding device cards' toggles and sliders to match.

targets.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Dashboard
targets.description: On any device power toggle or dimmer change, emit the device ID, on/off state, and load level; the Energy Usage Dashboard recalculates and re-renders current live wattage and per-device consumption breakdown.

targets.name: Smart Home: Status Header Bar
targets.description: On device state changes, emit the updated count of currently active devices; the Status Header Bar updates its 'devices on' summary indicator.

defs.name: Smart Home: Climate Thermostat Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a thermostat control for the active room: circular/dial setpoint control with current temperature and humidity readout, mode selector (heat/cool/auto/off), and fan speed. Serves climate adjustment per room.
defs.role: The dedicated climate controller for the scoped room, driven by room selection and scene activation to set target temperature and mode.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigation Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected room ID and loads that room/zone's current temperature, humidity, setpoint, and mode into the dial and readouts.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scenes & Automation Panel
effectors.description: When a scene is activated, receives the scene's target temperature and HVAC mode and updates the dial setpoint, mode selector, and fan speed accordingly.

defs.name: Smart Home: Security Monitoring Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a security panel showing live camera thumbnails, door/window sensor statuses, smart lock lock/unlock toggles, and an arm/disarm alarm control for the active room or whole home. Serves home security monitoring and control.
defs.role: The security surveillance and access-control surface, scoped by room selection and affected by scenes, that reports overall security state to the status header.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Room Navigation Sidebar
effectors.description: Receives the selected room ID and filters displayed camera feeds, sensors, and locks to that room (or shows all when 'Whole Home').

effectors.name: Smart Home: Scenes & Automation Panel
effectors.description: When a scene is activated (e.g. 'Away' or 'Night'), receives the scene's security directives and locks/unlocks doors and arms/disarms the alarm accordingly.

targets.name: Smart Home: Status Header Bar
targets.description: On alarm arm/disarm or lock state change, emit the overall security status (armed/disarmed, all-locked/unlocked); the Status Header Bar updates its security shield indicator.

defs.name: Smart Home: Scenes & Automation Panel
defs.genInstructions: Build a panel of one-tap scene tiles (Good Morning, Away, Movie Night, Bedtime) plus a list of automation rules with enable toggles; activating a scene pushes a coordinated state across devices, climate, and security.
defs.role: The orchestration surface that fires coordinated preset states across the device grid, thermostat, and security panel in a single tap.

targets.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
targets.description: On scene tile activation, emit the scene's per-device state map (on/off, brightness, color); the Device Control Grid applies these states to its device cards.

targets.name: Smart Home: Climate Thermostat Panel
targets.description: On scene tile activation, emit the scene's target temperature and HVAC mode; the Climate Thermostat Panel updates its setpoint and mode.

targets.name: Smart Home: Security Monitoring Panel
targets.description: On scene tile activation, emit the scene's security directive; the Security Monitoring Panel locks/unlocks doors and arms/disarms the alarm.

defs.name: Smart Home: Energy Usage Dashboard
defs.genInstructions: Build an energy dashboard showing live whole-home power draw, a time-series consumption chart, and a per-device/per-room breakdown with cost estimate. Serves energy monitoring and awareness.
defs.role: The consumption analytics surface that visualizes live and historical energy use, updated in real time by device state changes from the grid.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
effectors.description: Receives device on/off and load-level changes and recalculates live wattage, updates the consumption chart, and refreshes the per-device breakdown and cost estimate.

defs.name: Smart Home: Status Header Bar
defs.genInstructions: Build a top header bar showing home name, current time/date, local weather, an active-devices summary, and a security status indicator. Serves at-a-glance whole-home status.
defs.role: The always-visible summary banner that surfaces time, weather, active-device count, and security state aggregated from the other components.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Device Control Grid
effectors.description: Receives the running count of active devices and updates the 'devices on' summary indicator.

effectors.name: Smart Home: Security Monitoring Panel
effectors.description: Receives the overall security status (armed/disarmed, locked state) and updates the security shield indicator's color and label.
